data.name: DatabaseFilesIncomplete
data.value: Database '{0}' has a directory without a database in it, or creation stopped before both initial data pages were flushed. Creation never completed. Clear this incomplete file set with DropDatabaseAsync, then call CreateDatabaseAsync again.

data.name: DatabaseFilesUnrecoverable
data.value: Database '{0}' has missing or unrecoverable storage files. Preserve all files and restore the complete file set from backup. OpenDatabaseAsync requires the original journal and backup; replacing a missing sidecar could discard acknowledged commits or reopen a partially dropped database.

data.name: DatabaseOpenFailed
data.value: Database '{0}' could not be opened because a storage operation failed. Retry OpenDatabaseAsync after the condition is resolved. {1}

data.name: UploadFailed
data.value: The blob upload has failed and cannot be published.

data.name: UploadTransactionInactive
data.value: The blob upload's transaction is no longer active.

data.name: TransactionCommitAborted
data.value: The session's transaction is aborted and cannot commit; nothing was committed.

data.name: TransactionOperationsAborted
data.value: The session's transaction is aborted; operations are refused until it is rolled back.

data.name: OperationTransactionInactive
data.value: The blob operation's transaction is no longer active.

data.name: ChunkLengthInvalid
data.value: Blob chunk length or next location disagrees with catalog length.
